## Checklist

- [ ] The title uses Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `test:`, `chore:`).
- [ ] `make check` passes.
- [ ] Tests cover the change.
- [ ] The docs show the change.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `Unreleased`.
- [ ] If the change makes or changes a design decision, an ADR in `docs/adr/` records it.
- [ ] User-facing text follows the writing rules in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] Each new dependency is on the allowed list, or the pull request gives the reason for it.
